Verity Review: Blue's Very Fast Speed Merchant
Verity, The Mysterious Merchant: Selling Pain at Very Fast Speeds
Verity is a Legendary Ice hero from the
family, released during the Wilderness Summon event. As a

mana speed Wizard, she fits the archetype of a "blitz" attacker—designed to fire early and often. While her release was marked by some confusion regarding her skill set (more on that later), she settled into a role as a high-pressure flank or wing who forces enemies into a "pick your poison" scenario. She doesn't have a costume yet, so this review focuses entirely on her base form.

Verity's design is... distinctive. She sports the signature "Faun" aesthetic with large, curling horns and somewhat uncanny ears. She's depicted as a merchant, carrying an enormous backpack filled with wares (including a sword she doesn't seem to use) and holding a pair of bright red boots. The art style leans into the whimsical and slightly comical side of high fantasy, which might not be everyone's cup of tea if you prefer the gritty realism of the newer "Construct" or "Garrison" heroes.

Upon release, Verity (and her family) introduced the "Enhanced" ailments. Initially, there was confusion as her skill seemed to be swapped with the green hero, Peregrine, during Beta. She launched as a high-impact damage dealer.

Her raw stats have fallen behind. A hit of 350% off ~1450 attack is still painful, but it's no longer the team-wiping threat it was a year ago against modern defense stats (1600+ Defense). Defensively, she is now quite fragile and can be one-shot by modern snipers.
She is still a menace in

wars and tournaments due to her mana resistance and high damage. In standard wars, she is best used on offense where you can leverage her speed to snipe corners, or on defense in the Wing position to punish bad boards. She is no longer a premium tank or flank option.

If you pulled Verity, congratulations! She is a fantastic offensive weapon. Focus on getting her mana troops up to maximize her Very Fast speed. She will carry you through map stages and lower-tier raids purely on damage output.

She is a luxury toy. If you lack the latest OP heroes, she is a solid depth piece for War teams, especially for cleanup or Rush wars. However, think twice before committing Alpha Aethers (LB2) unless you really need the stat boost to keep her alive. There are stronger Blues in the current portal rotation (like the Construct or Astral heroes).
When released, players were baffled because beta information suggested she had a Dodge skill (which went to Peregrine). As one forum user noted,
"They swapped the specials of this one and the green one and toned them both down."
Players quickly realized the value of her ailment. One user mentioned,
"It’s kind of a caveat because do you dispel it and then take the negative Mana generation or do you allow the special skills to hit harder... I like that actually."
Despite stat creep, the community agrees:
"440% on 3 at VF speed… we are reaching new heights"
(Note: actual damage is 350%, but the sentiment on speed remains).

Verity is like a flashy sports car from three years ago: still faster than most things on the road, but lacking the modern safety features and armor of the new tanks. She sells a very specific brand of pain—fast, unavoidable, and tricky to cleanse. If you can keep her alive long enough to fire twice, you've likely won the match.
A strong offensive tool for your roster, particularly for Rush wars, but use her with caution in the top-tier meta where she might shatter like glass.
